diagIntro: Checks the stored receipt history and current settings. It does not auto-refresh or send a test event.
diagGeneratedAtNote: · {timeZone}. The latest new receipt covers the whole project regardless of period or schema, and duplicate resends do not update it. An old or missing record does not by itself mean an outage.
diagPausedNotice: This project is paused, so new collection requests are rejected. {action}
diagPausedActionEditor: You can change its status in the project settings below.
diagPausedActionViewer: Ask the project owner to resume collection.
diagRetiredNotice: This schema is retired. Check the version the SDK uses and the active published schema.
diagServerNotice: Server publishing does not use browser allowed origins. Check the sending service's publisher credentials and this project's publishing permission.
diagNoOriginsNotice: The allowed origins list is empty, so all browser collection is blocked.
diagOriginHelp: Compared on this tab only. Paths are excluded, and the protocol, host and port must match exactly. The address is never sent to the server or stored.
diagOriginAllowed: This origin is allowed. Actual sending and receipt still need separate checks.
diagOriginDeniedEditor: Add the origin in the settings below.
diagOriginDeniedViewer: Ask the project owner to add the origin.
diagOriginInvalid: Enter an http or https address. Addresses that contain sign-in details cannot be used.
diagOriginEmpty: Enter a service URL to compare it with the allowlist.
diagTroubleshooting: What to check when events are missing
diagTroubleshootingNote: Rejection records can have gaps. These are checks to run, not a record of actual failures, and a configured limit is not usage or remaining quota.
diagCheck1Server: Check that the project allows collection and that the dedicated publisher token's issuer, audience and project publishing permission match.
diagCheck1Browser: Check that the project allows collection and that the service origin is on the allowlist.
diagCheck2: Check that the SDK's project ID and schema version match the registered event names and property types.
diagCheck3Server: Check the server SDK's send result and HTTP status. 401 and 403 mean publisher credentials or permission need checking.
diagCheck3Browser: Check the collection response in the browser developer tools network panel.
diagCheck3Limit: 429 means a request or daily limit was reached. Wait according to the response's Retry-After.
diagCheck4: Check the error code and requestId in the response. 503 means checking storage status. Do not include tokens or raw payloads in a report.
diagLoadFailed: Could not read the diagnostics result. Try again.
rejectHeading: Collection rejections in the last 7 days
rejectIntro: Whole project · by UTC receipt date. Only stored rejected requests are counted. A request with several events still counts as one rejection.
rejectError: Could not read rejection records: {message} Use Recheck collection status above to query again.
rejectRangeNote: UTC. Records can be missing when storage failed or the aggregation predates this feature. Do not use this count to calculate an overall rejection rate or remaining quota.
rejectEmpty: No rejected requests were recorded in this period.
rejectReasonCaption: Rejected requests by reason in the last 7 days · times in UTC
rejectDayCaption: Rejected requests by UTC date · newest date first
healthIntro: Checks whether administrator storage can be read. Event storage and cleanup are separate checks.
identityIntro: This is the administrator account the server verified. Use the issuer and account identifier here for the first permission grant. An operator grants project creation permission separately.
identityCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the JSON below and copy it manually.
reportIntro1: Choose a JSON report created by logs:summary. The file is read only in the browser and is never sent to or stored on the server.
reportIntro2: This summarizes logs for the whole collector. It is separate from the project and period above, and the report's time range is unknown.
reportLoaded: Report loaded. Successful responses are sampled at 1/64.
obsIntro1: Observed responses are the lines actually counted in the received logs. The request estimate weights the success sample and adds it up, so it is not an exact request count.
obsIntro2: Of {lines} input lines, {blank} blank lines and {other} lines that were not collection logs were ignored. Duplicate lines for the same request or run ({duplicate}) were counted once.
obsNoDiagnostics: This report has no diagnostics object. It is a v2 report made before diagnostics existed, so error and review findings could not be classified. The summary above and the per-operation and cleanup totals below are still available.
obsNoFindings: No diagnostic findings were classified in the supplied logs. Findings with a zero count are omitted.
obsFindingsNote: A response is not counted under more than one finding. Counts are lines observed in the logs, not weights or failure rates.
obsFindingsCaption: Error and review findings classified from the observed logs
obsNoOperations: The received logs contain no HTTP responses. This report has cleanup records only.
obsOperationsNote: Only operations present in the logs are shown. Response tables show {size} lines per operation, and latency buckets come from coarse collector buckets, so a bucket stays Not measured when start and finish times cannot be measured.
obsResponseCaption: Observed response lines and estimated requests by status and code for {label}
obsLatencyCaption: Observed response lines and estimated requests by latency bucket for {label}
obsSaturatedTables: Tables that hit the delete limit
obsOldestExpired: Longest observed delay for an expired receipt
obsCapacityLimited: Projects where the cleanup limit is below configured intake
obsExecutionNote: Time and page limits carried over to the next run. Completing a pass does not mean every expired record was deleted, and the cursor can pass failed work. {count} runs recorded a schedule delay.
obsMetricsNote: Based on {count} projects that were measured successfully. This does not indicate expired data left in the whole database or actual processing speed.
obsNoCleanupLog: No cleanup logs were observed, so the number of processed projects is unknown.
obsNoCleanupDetail: Only a failure marker exists, with no detailed report, so the number of processed projects is unknown.
obsCleanupNote: Attempt, success and failure counts are totals from runs that have a detailed report. They are not unique project counts or deleted row counts, and processing in a failed run without details is unknown.
savingNote: Saving. No other change can start until it finishes.
retrySameRequest: Check again with the same request
staleListNote: Check the latest list before starting a new change.
saveResultFailed: Could not confirm the save result.
changesLost: Owner permission could not be confirmed, so change history was closed. Check the latest settings or connection.
changesNoAccess: With owner permission in Settings, change history is available. Accounts connected with reader permission do not see this history.
changesIntro: Shows changes from the API and registration tools in the last 90 days since this feature was introduced.
changesEmpty: No changes were recorded in the last 90 days.
changesTableCaption: Administrator changes in the last 90 days: time, actor, change
changesFooter: Shows up to 25 changes per page. Changes added later appear after Reload from start.
grantsIntro: Owners can add accounts, switch between reader and owner, or revoke access. Every change is reviewed before saving.
grantsLost: Owner permission could not be confirmed, so the list and change controls were closed. Check the latest settings or connection.
grantsNoAccess: With owner permission in Settings, the list is available. Accounts connected with reader permission do not see the list.
grantsAddHelp: Enter the sign-in provider's issuer and account identifier (sub) exactly. They can differ from the email address.
grantsUnloadConfirm: Discard the permission change under review and re-read the list?
grantsEmpty: No permissions to show on this page. Reload from start to check the current list again.
grantsTableCaption: Account identifiers, issuers, roles, registration times and permission changes for this project
grantsFooter: Shows 25 permissions per page, ordered by issuer and identifier. Permissions added earlier appear after Reload from start.
grantImpact: If the account you are signed in with is this target, you are lowering or revoking your own permission. After saving, you cannot change it again on this screen.
publishersIntro: Only accounts in this list may publish from servers. This is separate from administrator reader and owner permissions, and grants and revocations are reviewed before saving.
publishersLost: Owner permission could not be confirmed, so the list and change controls were closed. Check the latest settings or connection.
publishersNoAccess: With owner permission in Settings, the list is available. Accounts connected with reader permission do not see the list.
publishersAddHelp: Enter the issuer and account identifier (sub) the publishing service signs in with. This grants server publishing only, not administrator access.
publishersUnloadConfirm: Discard the publishing change under review and re-read the list?
publishersEmpty: No publishers to show on this page. Reload from start to check the current list again.
publishersTableCaption: Server publisher account identifiers, issuers, registration times and permission revocation for this project
publishersFooter: Shows 25 publishers per page, ordered by issuer and identifier. On narrow screens, scroll the table sideways to reach the revoke button. Publishers added earlier appear after Reload from start.
publisherRevokeScope: Revokes the selected publishing permission. A permission granted again later is not revoked.
publisherSeparateNote: Server publishing is separate from administrator reader and owner permissions. Granting it does not grant project read access.
publisherSaveFailed: Could not save the publishing permission.
createIntro: The server checks project creation permission. Input is kept only in this screen's memory.
createNameHelp: Name shown in the admin list, 1–80 characters.
createIdHelp: Starts with a lowercase letter and uses lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot be changed after creation.
createTimeZoneHelp: IANA time zone name. It cannot be changed after creation.
createOriginsHelp: One origin per line, up to 16. Leave empty for server-only projects. An empty list blocks browser collection. Exclude paths; HTTP is only for allowed local development.
createRequestsPerMinuteHelp: Integer from 1 to 600. The default is 120.
createDailyLimitHelp: Integer from 1 to 1,000,000. The default is 100,000.
createLimitsSummary: Collection limits · {requestsPerMinute} per minute / {newReceiptsPerUtcDay} per day
createUncertain: Retrying with the same details confirms whether creation succeeded. If it was not saved yet, this request creates it.
createConfirmSame: Confirm creation with the same request
createConfirmHelp: Confirms without changing the input. Disconnecting or closing the screen discards this draft.
createDiscardConfirm: Discard the project details you are writing and close?
overviewContext: {source} events · last 7 days and previous 7 days in each service's time zone · today still aggregating · rejections cover the whole project for the last 7 UTC days
overviewDateChanged: The reference time and this device's date now differ. Check the displayed period and refresh the service overview.
overviewLoading: Checking service health for this page.
overviewLoadFailed: Could not load the service overview. Try again.
overviewRowError: Could not query this service. Check permission and the connection, then try again.
overviewNotesBody: Latest receipt and rejection records are read even without an active schema. At most five services are read at a time, with no automatic repeat queries. Completion uses each version's representative workflow; change appears only when neither period is still aggregating and each has at least 30 starts. This is not statistical significance or an outage threshold. Requests blocked before the collector are not counted as rejections. A missing receipt alone does not mean an outage.
loginNotConfigured: The sign-in provider is not configured yet. It becomes available after operator setup. Until then, you can explore the analysis screens with sample data.
loginFailed: Could not complete sign-in. Check the provider settings and sign in again.
loginConfigError: The sign-in provider is missing or misconfigured. Ask the operator to check the settings.
